premises.text: Curb Karma is a smartphone social network that finds and reserves parking where and when needed

premises.text: Leavers earn a $1 Karma Credit; seekers spend two credits, with one credit going to Curb Karma

premises.text: Capturing a small share of high-demand urban spot exchanges yields city-scale then multi-city revenue
